about_the_game:
It’s John’s House – A Game You Were Never Meant to Win

You shouldn’t be here. But now that you are, he won’t let you leave.

Dr. John Ravenwood—a ghoul with a sinister sense of humour—has invited you to play his little game. Your only chance of survival is to spot the anomalies haunting each room. Something has moved. Something has changed. Something is watching. Find it before it finds you.

Because if you fail, Mama will come. And she doesn’t let anyone escape.

The Rules Are Simple:

🔹 Find the Anomalies – Every room holds a paranormal disturbance. Identify it correctly to move on.
🔹 Choose Wisely – Mark the wrong anomaly, and John will be very disappointed. Disappointment leads to punishment.
🔹 Hide or Run – If you anger the house, Mama will come for you. You can try to run, you can try to hide—but you can’t escape her.
🔹 Endless Loops – The house won’t let you leave. You’re stuck in a repeating cycle, forced to play John’s game until you get it right… or die trying.
🔹 A Voice You Can’t Ignore – Dr. John Ravenwood is always watching, always talking. His voice follows you through the radios, taunting, guiding… toying with you.

An Ever-Changing Nightmare

Each playthrough is different. The anomalies shift. The rules may twist. The house wants to break you.

There is no escape—only survival. Can you outplay John and make it out alive?

content_descriptors.notes: It's John's House features psychological horror with blood and gore (e.g., blood pools and stains on walls). The game includes disturbing themes, supernatural elements, and moments of violence, but no sexual content or nudity. It is intended for players who are comfortable with unsettling imagery and dark, intense horror.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 5700
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: A psychological horror game with memory-based gameplay. Identify paranormal anomalies to progress, but choose carefully—one mistake could be fatal. Hide, run, and survive as Dr. John Ravenwood taunts you through the radio. The house is watching, and it never lets go.

*languages with full audio support
